title: Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
description: Follow Alice down the rabbit-hole, through wordplay, riddles and wonderfully peculiar conversations.
edition_note: Complete twelve-chapter original English text. A text-only edition: source illustrations are omitted. Paragraphs, verse line breaks and italic emphasis are retained.
rights_basis: Original literary text: public domain in the USA (source catalogue) and Germany (UrhG §§64,69; author died more than 70 calendar years ago). No modern translation or illustrations included. Source distribution terms are retained in every edition.

title: Candide, ou l’optimisme
author: Voltaire
description: Candide travels an uncertain world in Voltaire’s brisk, sharp French satire.
edition_note: Complete thirty-chapter original French narrative. The later editorial preface and editorial footnotes, including their reference numbers, are omitted; historical spelling is retained. This is not a modern translation.
rights_basis: Original literary text: public domain in the USA (source catalogue) and Germany (UrhG §§64,69; author died more than 70 calendar years ago). No modern translation or illustrations included. Source distribution terms are retained in every edition.

title: Die Verwandlung
author: Franz Kafka
description: Gregor Samsa wakes into an impossible morning. Read Kafka’s complete three-part novella in German.
edition_note: Complete three-part original German narrative. The source publisher’s front matter is omitted. Historical spelling and paragraph divisions are retained.
rights_basis: Original literary text: public domain in the USA (source catalogue) and Germany (UrhG §§64,69; author died more than 70 calendar years ago). No modern translation or illustrations included. Source distribution terms are retained in every edition.
